correctness.rationale: Direct point/hyperplane identification and U T U^T factorization. Exact hyperplane counts lead to a nonsingular directed-pair elimination for every eigenvalue except 0,beta,±gamma; the point-sum system confines all others to k,±gamma^(3/2). Explicit independent centered point-function eigenvectors realize ±bands with v−1 dimensions; constant vector realizes k once. Exact tr A^0,A,A^2,A^3 and the verified local common-neighbor number solve the four remaining multiplicities uniquely, including m0=0. Three independent finite prime-field checker calculations match all multiplicities. Numerical checks are not used to infer the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The complete spectral invariant of a canonical matrix-commutativity graph is a natural global feature independent of local valency/triangle data. It gives exact nonsingularity and rank for every finite field, a q=2 loss of one positive band, and infinitely many provably nonintegral odd-dimensional graph instances. A general closed form for all n>=4 is not a small numerical extension.
